title: Lung Volume Reduction Surgery (Reduction Pneumoplasty)
benefit_category: Inpatient Hospital Services, Outpatient Hospital Services Incident to a Physician's Service, Physicians' Services
item_service_description:
<strong><p>  A. General</p> </strong>
 
<p>  Lung volume reduction surgery (LVRS) or reduction pneumoplasty, also referred to as lung shaving or lung contouring, is performed on patients with severe emphysema in order to allow the remaining compressed lung to expand, and thus, improve respiratory function.&#160; Medicare-covered LVRS approaches are limited to bilateral excision of a damaged lung with stapling performed via median sternotomy or video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery.</p>
